correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<p<1, the angular q_p profile has four |t|^p/p cusps. The true conic sine-hat interpolation coefficients differ uniformly by O(h²) from ordinary angular interpolation, which is o(h^p). Away from K h neighborhoods of the axes, second-derivative control yields O(K^(p-2)h^p), so the full supremum localizes to integer-grid or half-integer-grid |u|^p chords. On aligned cells concavity and convexity of derivative give max (1-p)p^(p/(1-p))/p; on midpoint cells the Hölder/Jensen bound yields 1/(p2^p), attained at the centered cusp. For p=1 an axis-aligned fan reproduces |x|+|y| exactly, whereas the midpoint sector gives exactly tan(h/2). Independent double-precision direct conic sample checks for p=.5,.75,.95 and N=200,201,400,401 corroborate limit trends; at p=.5 odd N=401 scaled error≈1.458 vs asymptotic 1.414 due slowly vanishing O(h^p) corrections. Finite grids are not proofs.
